title: VoiceInboxEnrichedRecord
description: Durable record persisted by the intake workflow for each successfully processed capture: capture metadata, source reference, transcript, first-pass note, model result, workflow/prompt/schema version fields, and approval_state (see local-voice-inbox-mvp-implementation-plan.md, 'Implementation Changes'). approval_state must always include 'not_requested' -- the only value the MVP pipeline currently writes, since no approval workflow exists yet. Other enum values are reserved for a future approval gate.

schema_version.description: Version of this enriched-record schema. Breaking changes require a major version bump and a migration note; additive fields are minor-version only.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this enriched record.

source.description: Reference back to the originating Superwhisper capture, and the idempotency key used to detect duplicate events.

source_path_hash.description: Hash of the source recording path/identity, used as the idempotency key so a repeated event is not re-processed.

captured_at.description: Original capture timestamp, copied from capture_metadata for convenient querying.

capture_metadata.description: The full original Superwhisper meta.json payload for this capture.

transcript.description: Raw transcript, denormalized from capture_metadata.transcript for direct access.

first_pass_note.description: Superwhisper first-pass note, denormalized from capture_metadata.first_pass_note.

model_result.description: Structured output returned by the OpenAI Responses API call for this capture.

workflow_version.description: Version/tag of the n8n intake workflow definition that produced this record.

prompt_version.description: Version/tag of the enrichment prompt used for this record.

model_config_version.description: Version/tag of the single configurable model value (model name + reasoning tier together, e.g. 'gpt-5.6-luna:low') used for this record. See 'Model configuration decision' in the plan document.

approval_state.description: Human approval state for this record. The MVP pipeline always writes 'not_requested'; the other values are reserved for a future approval workflow and are not produced by this version of the system.

created_at.description: Timestamp this enriched record was written to the durable inbox.
